summary: Top hypothesis: ORB-H1 (Trade ORB only after a negative 20-day index return) with priority score 4.2.

hypotheses.title: Trade ORB only after a negative 20-day index return
hypotheses.thesis: Opening-range breakouts follow through more often after the index has fallen over the prior 20 days.
hypotheses.problem_target: Many intraday stop-outs in calm uptrends
hypotheses.mechanism: After declines realised volatility and dealer short-gamma rise, so intraday moves extend instead of mean-reverting; in grinding uptrends the open range is noise.
evidence_basis: IS avg R 0.76 after negative 20d return (470 trades) vs 0.23 after positive (735)

proposed_rule_changes.change: skip ORB entry when index 20-day return up to prior close > 0

key_risks: drops 60 % of trades incl. big winners
2019-2022 IS contains 2020 crash and 2022 bear market, overrepresenting declines

hypotheses.title: Skip ORB in growth-slowing x inflation-accelerating regime
hypotheses.thesis: ORB expectancy collapses when growth slows while inflation accelerates (stagflation tilt).
hypotheses.mechanism: Rate-shock driven sessions reverse after the open as macro headlines dominate intraday flow.
evidence_basis: IS avg R 0.13 (249 trades) vs 0.44-0.67 in other growth-up regimes
